      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {

      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial CNN weights, biases, and trainable latent vector",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.1 and Appendix C identify random network initializations without distributions, actual parameter arrays, or reproducible seeds. The uniform 0.3 initialization in C.2 applies to the standard parameterization.",

        "Glorot-uniform weights, zero biases, standard-normal latent vector, seeds 0 through 4",
        "Glorot-normal weights, zero biases, uniform [-1,1] latent vector, seeds 10 through 14"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Adam moment-decay coefficients at both levels",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3 specifies Adam, learning-rate rules, clipping, and denominator safeguards but does not give its first- and second-moment decay coefficients.",
      "readings": [
        "Use moment decays (0.9,0.999) at both levels",
        "Use moment decays (0.9,0.99) at both levels"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Fixed UL normalization constants c_ref and d_ref",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (18) and Appendix C say the references come from one random network initialization and remain fixed, but give neither their values nor the reference state and filter settings.",
      "readings": [
        "Compute both references from the first network initialization with beta=0.05 and r_min=2",
        "Compute both references from a separate fixed network initialization with beta=1 and r_min=2"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial LL unroll horizon for Fig. 5",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3 discusses starts at one or two steps and recommends two for loss hyperparameters. No Fig. 5 value is stated explicitly; Appendix A.1 additionally reserves budget for t=1.",
      "readings": [
        "Start with t_start=1",
        "Start with t_start=2, requiring a decision about the stated t=1 reserve"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Total computational budget for Fig. 5",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Algorithm 1 and Appendix A require B_max, but no numerical MBB budget is supplied in the text or Fig. 5 caption.",
      "readings": [
        "B_max=10000 under the selected accounting convention",
        "B_max=20000 under the selected accounting convention"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Units used to charge the computational budget",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3 and Appendix A describe cumulative LL iterations, while Algorithm 1 charges 4t+2 per UL update and Appendix C.3 identifies that quantity as linear solves.",
      "readings": [
        "Charge t actual LL optimizer iterations per UL update",
        "Charge 4t+2 linear-solve equivalents per UL update"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Annealing-stage budget allocation",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Appendix A.1 specifies exponential decay with factor 0.1 and stage reserves without an allocation formula or an exact rule combining weights and reserves.",
      "readings": [
        "Reserve 20% for t=1 and 10% for t=10; distribute the remaining 70% with weights exp(-0.1*(t-1))",
        "Reserve 20% for t=1 and 10% for t=10; distribute the remaining 70% with weights 0.1^(t-1)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Oscillation-trigger interpretation",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Appendix A.2 calls Eq. (27) an oscillation detector but tests signed r<0.5. Monotonic objective decrease gives r=-1 and therefore also satisfies that test.",
      "readings": [
        "Implement the literal condition r<0.5 for 30 consecutive UL iterations",
        "Implement |r|<0.5 for 30 consecutive UL iterations to detect cancellation from oscillation"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
